'''The Next Generation: Supplemental''' is the 12th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 13 April 2012. This set consists of 45 cards. This set is part of the ''The Next Generation Block'' consisting of cards from [[The Next Generation]], [[The Next Generation: Supplemental]], [[Engage]], [[The Sky's the Limit]], [[Coming of Age (expansion)|Coming of Age]], and [[Q Who? (expansion)|Q Who?]] virtual expansions.


==Type Breakdown==
*8 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*4 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 1 Klingon and 1 Romulan)
*3 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*19 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (8 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 6 Klingon, 5 Non-Aligned and 1 Romulan)
*8 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (3 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 2 Klingon, 1 Non-Aligned and 1 Romulan)

'''NOTE:''' There is 1 Multiple-affiliation card, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
